chunks: [Condemning the disobedient ones:] Beware! You have shaken your hands loose from the rope of obedience,
and broken the divine fort around you by (resorting to) pre-Islamic rules.
Certainly, it is a great blessing of Allāh, the Glorified, on this Ummah, that He has engendered among them unity through the cord of affection in whose shade they walk and take shelter.
This is a blessing whose value no one in the whole world realises, because it is more valuable than any price and higher than any wealth.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of unity (al-ulfa) in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the community for abandoning the 'rope of obedience' and adopting the fragmented customs of the Jahiliyyah, thereby weakening their spiritual fortress. He elevates 'al-ulfa' (unity/cohesion' (al-ulfa) as a divine, intangible blessing that provides collective security and holds a value surpassing all material wealth, a concept central to Shia political theology regarding the preservation of the Ummah.
